segments.name: Formula 1
segments.evidence: Formula 1 also generates revenue from a variety of other sources, including the operation of the Formula 1 Paddock Club hospitality program (the "Paddock Club"), freight, logistical and travel related services for the Formula 1 Teams and other third parties, the F2 and F3 race series, which run principally as support races during Formula 1 Event weekends, F1 Academy, various television production and post-production activities
